title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Thirunelveli
desc: Thulasi, a highly respected man in the village, is known for his truthfulness in all circumstances. But the real testing time arrives when his good trait brings a lot of trouble to the family.

title: Manaivikku Mariyathai
desc: Priya decides to work after her husband loses his job, despite his initial reluctance. Trouble ensues when Priya's employer falls in love with her and forces her to marry him.

title: Makkal En Pakkam
desc: Childhood friends Samraj and Rajmohan become enemies after Samraj is falsely accused of theft. While Samraj becomes a smuggler, he constantly faces problems due to Rajmohan's political influence.

title: Pambara Kannale
desc: Arumugam, a poor man, comes to Ooty for a job and falls in love with Pooja. However, Pooja is engaged to marry Gautam, an evil and deceptive person.

title: Paattali
desc: Despite being the sole heir to a large fortune, Shanmugam is forced to work as a servant by his aunt. Circumstances force him to marry Kannamma even though he is in love with Shakuntala.
